description: Google Maps patch for ReVanced GmsCore, enabled by default for Morphe Desktop Quick mode. Adds compatibility for Google Maps 26.30.09.950492155 while preserving the existing package, provider, permission, Timeline semantic location, MicroG account access, Phenotype service, Google Intent action routing, and original Picture-in-Picture declaration. Also supports stable target 26.29.02.946673643 and earlier compatible targets 26.28.03.942936911, 26.27.05.941319029, and 26.26.04.935742811.
